projects.title: Config-Driven GitOps Framework for Enterprise Data Platforms
projects.shortDesc: API-driven TFE workflow using JSON configurations to automate infrastructure for 150+ developers across 10 AWS accounts.
projects.description: Architected a massive-scale, cloud-agnostic GitOps framework that abstracts infrastructure complexity via JSON-based configurations. The system uses a core Terraform engine to parse environment-specific JSON files and programmatically trigger TFE API-driven workflows. Designed for cross-platform portability, the pattern enables seamless multi-cloud deployments across AWS, Azure, and GCP through a unified abstraction layer. Implemented trunk-based development to manage 10+ accounts and 4 environment tiers (Dev, QA, Pre-prod, Prod) through centralized, reusable modules.
projects.role: Lead Infrastructure SRE and DevOps Engineer
contributions: Engineered JSON-based config engine parsing environment-specific definitions into dynamic Terraform configurations
Developed API-driven integration with Terraform Enterprise for automated workspace management and plan/apply triggers
Implemented trunk-based branching strategy for high-velocity infrastructure delivery across 10 AWS accounts
Constructed a centralized library of reusable Terraform modules enforcing enterprise security and governance
Architected the CI/CD orchestration layer bridging GitLab repositories with TFE API endpoints
results: Empowered 150+ developers with automated infrastructure self-service
Standardized infrastructure delivery across 4 environments (Dev, QA, Pre-prod, Prod)
Eliminated manual TFE workspace configuration through programmatic API orchestration
Accelerated deployment frequency while maintaining 100% compliance with central security modules
Achieved cross-platform portability enabling consistent infrastructure governance across AWS and Azure
